LanguageData.DMS_SyntheticApparelRepair_EnableApparel: Allow eligible synthetic mechs to repair worn apparel. Body damage repair is unaffected.
LanguageData.DMS_SyntheticApparelRepair_ApparelEnergy: Energy multiplier per apparel hit point repaired, relative to MechEnergyLossPerHP. Zero is free; 10% is the default.
LanguageData.DMS_SyntheticApparelRepair_EnableWeaponR: Allow eligible DMS and integrated weapon-capable mechs to repair equipped weapons. Body damage repair is unaffected.
LanguageData.DMS_SyntheticApparelRepair_WeaponEnergyF: Energy multiplier per non-standard weapon hit point repaired, relative to MechEnergyLossPerHP. Zero is free; 10% is the default.
LanguageData.DMS_SyntheticApparelRepair_StandardWeapo: Energy multiplier per AutomatroidWeapon hit point repaired, relative to MechEnergyLossPerHP. Zero is free and the default.
LanguageData.DMS_SyntheticApparelRepair_SettingsNote: Costs are paid from the repairing mech's energy. Milira's native repair energy rules remain unchanged. If DMS Synthetic is not installed, only weapon repair is active.
